title: AARP Celebrated the Power of Music, Reinvention and Legacy at Billboard Latin Music Week 2026
summary: From the Latin Music Legacy Award presented by AARP to a cross-generational conversation with salsa icons Tito Nieves and Luis Figueroa, AARP championed the artists, stories and connections that kept Latin music thriving across generations.
contentText:
AARP took center stage at Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 as an official partner of one of Latin music’s most influential industry gatherings, celebrating the artists, executives and cultural voices shaping the genre across generations.

Latin music is a powerful example of how artists continue to evolve, inspire new audiences and build lasting connections across generations.

Richard Bull, George Prajin, Mac Clark and Rudy López Negrete and team at 2026 Billboard Latin Power Players held at Faena Theater on October 19, 2026 in Miami Beach, Florida.

Jose "Chepe" Devillegas

Through its partnership with Billboard Latin Music Week, AARP celebrated the pioneers who helped shape Latin music alongside the emerging voices carrying those traditions into the future.

One of the highlights of AARP’s programming was “Salsa Revival: Bridging Generations presented by AARP,” a panel featuring legendary salsa artist Tito Nieves and contemporary salsa star Luis Figueroa.

The conversation brought together two artists whose careers represent different eras of salsa, united by a shared commitment to keeping the genre alive and moving forward.

AARP also presented Tito Nieves with the Latin Music Legacy Award at Billboard Latin Power Players, recognizing his lasting impact on the genre and his contributions to Latin music.

Luis Figueroa and Tito Nieves speak onstage at the Salsa Revival: Bridging Generations panel during Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 held at Faena Forum on October 19, 2026 in Miami Beach, Florida.

“It’s a fantastic year for music, more than ever,” Billboard’s co-chief content officer Leila Cobo said during the ceremony. Citing Luminate data, she noted that one in every 10 streams is now in Spanish… double the share recorded six years ago. “We are so proud to honor [the Latin Power Players] tonight.”

AARP’s presence at Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 reflected a vision of aging centered on possibility, participation and continued growth. As a nonprofit dedicated to empowering people to choose how they live as they age, AARP highlighted the importance of lifelong creativity, cultural engagement and connections between generations.

Latin music brought that message to life. 

From honoring industry pioneers with the Latin Music Legacy Award to bringing Tito Nieves and Luis Figueroa together to discuss the evolution of salsa, AARP was part of the conversations where culture, community and generations connect.

Tito Nieves at 2026 Billboard Latin Power Players held at Faena Theater on October 19, 2026 in Miami Beach, Florida.

At Billboard Latin Music Week 2026, AARP delivered a clear message: Legacy is not just what people leave behind. It is what they continue to create, share and inspire at every age.
